I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 10 June and that I hadn't changed anything. I also offered to post the correction in #north-team if she wants that.

I didn't open #north-team to look at her original post, because she said no action was needed. A renewal date counts as an account fact, not a money figure, so repeating it in the channel was fine.
